findings.title: Lightness value changed inconsistently with surrounding pattern, inverting intended effect
findings.body: The diff changes `.embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a` color from `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`. Unlike all other conversions in this PR, which keep the first argument's lightness equal to the original value (e.g. 50%→50%, 60%→60%), this one changes 30% to 70% for the light-theme branch. This changes the actual rendered color in light theme mode, not just adding dark-theme support, which is an unintended visual regression/inconsistency for light themes.

findings.title: Lightness value changed inconsistently with surrounding pattern (20%→50%)
findings.body: In `.topic-map h3`, the color was changed from `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)` to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. The light-theme lightness value was changed from 20% to 50%, unlike the rest of the PR's pattern which preserves the original lightness for the light-theme branch and only adds a new value for the dark-theme branch. This alters existing light-theme appearance unintentionally.

findings.title: Lightness value changed inconsistently with surrounding pattern (30%→50%)
findings.body: `.group-member-info .name` color was changed from `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. This modifies the light-theme lightness from 30% to 50%, inconsistent with the stated purpose of only adding dark-theme support without altering light-theme colors, causing a visible light-theme regression.

findings.title: Lightness value changed inconsistently with surrounding pattern (30%→50%)
findings.body: `.group-member-info .name` color changed from `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`, altering the light-theme value from 30% to 50%, unlike all other conversions in the PR that preserve the original lightness for light themes.

findings.title: Lightness value changed inconsistently (70%→30%) for light theme
findings.body: `.custom-message-length` color changed from `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)` to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`. The light-theme lightness was changed from 70% to 30%, which is a much darker/stronger color than before, deviating from the pattern used elsewhere in the PR and causing unintended visual change for light themes.
